title: Experimental Observation of Time-Domain Bound States in The Continuum
summary: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) are spatially localized eigenmodes that remain perfectly confined even though their energies reside within a continuum of radiating modes. BICs were predicted in 1929, but their experimental realization awaited more than 8 decades. Following their experimental observation, BICs were explored in a variety of wave systems, and found to exhibit a plethora of fundamental features such nontrivial topology and extremely high Q-factor.
